lines: Mātṛkā, Mālinī, or-then: he should place in ether-sixteen-measured; in
supreme but two, having-placed-having-placed, before impelled-ones.
l4.sanskrit_cite: mātṛkāṃ mālinīṃ vātha nyasyetkhaśarasaṃmite uttame tu dvayīṃ nyasyennyasya pūrvaṃ pracoditān
